# Code of Conduct

Textfilters is maintained for focused, respectful collaboration around small
TypeScript text filtering packages.

Contributors are expected to:

- Treat other contributors with respect.
- Keep discussion technical, specific, and constructive.
- Avoid harassment, personal attacks, and disruptive behavior.
- Respect maintainer decisions about project scope and package boundaries.

Maintainers may edit, hide, lock, or remove content that violates these
expectations, and may restrict participation when needed to protect
contributors and project work.

For enforcement questions, contact the maintainers through GitHub issues or
security advisories when appropriate.
